rowText.after: A Yale student in New Haven picks between Yale Health Center's Student Health and Fair Haven Community Health Care on the rendered Your Doctor select. Each option says a visit's price and wait. From 2026-10-15 Yale Health's own rule is kept (“All care must be obtained at the Yale Health Center at 55 Lock Street unless it is an emergency situation or you have a referral with prior authorization…”, read again 2026-10-15). With nothing picked a member goes to Yale Health, the next weekday, at $0. A member who picks Fair Haven waits 24 days and is billed the uninsured's $183.98 (2026), SLATE's price, since Fair Haven publishes no fee. Yale Health pays none of it and none counts toward its out-of-pocket most. SLATE keeps no referral, so none is honored, and an emergency is unaffected. Somebody Yale Health doesn't cover is given Fair Haven, as before. An older save's default appointment moves to Yale Health on its first opening, once, and a recorded pick stays. A booking made with nothing picked is had where it was booked, whatever the cover does before its day: one made at Fair Haven while she was uncovered and kept once Yale Health covers her again is billed as the uninsured's, since Yale Health pays only at its own Health Center; canceled and booked again, it's at Yale Health. A reload changes none of it. The choice now moves the practice, the wait, the price and continuity.

rows.after: partial: The plan's part of a bill is real and played. A played life with need reaches a program renewal by the clock alone (tests/need-paths.test.ts): she is withdrawn, enrolled in HUSKY D on Papers, and her renewal on 1 November 2027 passes the income test on interest alone, then fails Connecticut's 2027 work test, so HUSKY D ends and she's told. A renewal that keeps a program is reached too: an Inherited family's student enrolls in Covered Connecticut on a personal leave, on January's interest, and it renews on 1 September 2027 on August's interest, by play alone (tests/scope-cover.test.ts); need-paths plays HUSKY D moved to Covered Connecticut at renewal. Until the recheck of 2026-10-15 this said no renewal that keeps a program was reached and Covered Connecticut's couldn't be: that reckoning assumed a family with need and work-study income, and overlooked the interest an Inherited life earns. What stays open is HUSKY D kept at renewal through work: SLATE pays wages only for work-study and the Summer Cabaret, both a student's, so a life off Yale Health has none, and the tests give it as TEST SETUP wages. From the recheck, HUSKY D's work test reads the School over last month, as 42 CFR 435.552(c) has it, at an application and at a renewal; until then it read the School at the instant asked, and a student at the School all of January 2027, withdrawn on 1 February, was refused on 2 February. HUSKY D kept by her being at the School is played (tests/scope-cover.test.ts, back from a leave). No income was invented and no eligibility loosened.
